profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java | Full Stack | AWS Certified | Building cloud based applications | Learning Golang
profile.summary: Primarily self-taught and self-driven Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building large, scalable applications with AWS cloud and full-stack Java. With a background in BioEngineering, I made the jump to full-time software development post-college. My motivations were fueled by my love of technology and building things. In former roles, I, reduced security vulnerabilities by 99%, sped up CI/CD timelines by over 50%, and reduced web application latency by 40%. All the while, I've kept up with self-development and personal growth by getting certified in AWS and continuing to learning skills that interest me, like Golang. In the future, I hope to continue growing as a well-rounded professional and seek to leverage my technical expertise to increase productivity for a team and company with a modern vision.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Transformed monolithic systems into microservice based architectures
- Developed and deployed dockerized APIs using latest SpringBoot on AWS ECS 
- Designed, developed and deployed a patented solution to dockerize and automate rehydration for workflow automation agents used for batch scheduling 
- Participated in internal hackathons yielding production ready solutions to critical Business intents 
- First point of contact / acting subject matter expert for various applications including SOAP and REST APIs, scheduled batch job service, SpringBoot UI and Postgres RDS databases 
- Interviewed over 20 candidates for Software Engineer positions. Certified interviewer for Full Time Associate positions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Second project for a financial company client where I was part of a sprint team which builds and maintains cornerstone applications for the companies Auto Finance division. Some of my notable contributions include:
-    Drove migration of web UI to SpringBoot resulting in 40% faster response times, simplified development process, 20% less maintenance costs and enhanced browser compatibility 
-    Reduced deployment time from over 1 hour to under 5 minutes by leveraging Docker and deployment onto AWS ECS
-  Remediated over 1000 vulnerabilities; including code changes, dependency updates and software patching, resulting in 99% fewer security compliance risks and safer infrastructure
-    Integrated monitoring tools: Splunk, Grafana and New Relic, to identify key latency bottlenecks
-    Designed and implemented architecture for moving a scheduled batch job application to SpringBoot and Docker resulting in reduced cost and quicker CI/CD pipelines 
-    Led adoption of open source technologies like OpenJDK and Apache servers
-    Directed the launch of 3 new applications into production

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
First project for a financial company client where I was part of a small sprint team developing a new ETL framework. Some of the achievements include:
-  Designed and developed a schedule driven Spark / Scala ETL framework to read, manipulate and store large datasets in locations and formats including S3, Parquet, Avro, CSV, JSON and tables in RDS and Snowflake
-  Built and configured Jenkins pipeline to deploy onto AWS EMR resulting in less manual oversight and 50% faster build and deploy process

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Trained in Java, SQL, DevOps Foundations, Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure. Certified as an Associate Architect in Snowflake. Placed on projects with clients outlined above.

positions.title: Resident
positions.description:
-Studied Python, MEAN and Ruby full stacks through a full-time coding boot camp.
-Built on the exposure to coding I had during college and developed the front end and back end skills necessary to build full stack projects by myself.
-Most importantly I discovered methods to learn new technologies quickly and efficient thus ensuring that I can continue to grow my knowledge base in the future.
-Graduated with the highest distinction in each stack.

Skills utilized: 
Languages: JavaScript, Python, Ruby, HTML5, CSS3, SQL
Frameworks: AngularJS, Express.js, Socket.io, Django, Flask, Rails, Twitter Bootstrap
Databases: MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Mongoose.js, Building ERDs
Other: GitHub, jQuery, Node.js, Sass, Ajax, RSpec, TDD, OOP, CRUD, RESTful architecture, MVC/MVT, AWS(EC2)

positions.title: Team Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and prototyped an easily adjustable intubation ramp for usage on patients of all ages and body types. Authored a design report detailing need, goals, prototype design, test methods and results. Presented at a research symposium.

Skills utilized: Experimental design, Research, Technical writing, Presentation, COMSOL, MATLAB, Inventor, MS Office, Teamwork, Requirements Gathering

company.name: Seattle Children's Hospital / University of Washington

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Studied DNA gate functionalized gold nanoparticles for use in biosensor mechanisms and drug delivery. Independent research project on toehold mediated displacement kinetics on gate functionalized gold nanoparticles thereby enabling more efficient usage and comprehension of the underlying mechanisms. Concluded with a comprehensive research paper and presentation. 

Skills utilized: Experimental design, Research, Technical Writing, Presentation, MATLAB, MS Office, Nupack, qPCR, DNA sequence design / testing, IDT DNA, Data Analysis, DNA probes,  Spectrometry, Fluorescent probes, Electrophoresis, Statistical Analysis

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Research Intern at a biotech firm working with cell culture, PCR and drug related procedures. Capped off with a solo project testing the efficacy of a novel cancer drug on HeLa cells using MTT assay.

projects.title: Reddit Clone
projects.description:
Python based clone of the popular content website Reddit.  Won first place for an in-house hackathon competition. Technologies utilized include: HTML, CSS with Twitter Bootstrap, JavaScript with jQuery, Python with Flask framework and a MySQL database. 

Video demo link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b-g-IpZrCQY

testScores.name: Ruby Belt Exam
testScores.description: Given a wire diagram we are tasked with building a multi-page CRUD application using Ruby on Rails with a functioning back-end, front-end and PostgreSQL database connection. Time limit was 4.5 hrs for completion of the assignment, deployment to an AWS EC2 server and creating a quick demo video.

testScores.name: MEAN Belt Exam
testScores.description: Given a wire diagram we are tasked with building a multi-page CRUD application with a functioning Node back-end, Angular front-end and MongoDb database connection. Time limit was 4.5 hrs for completion of the assignment, deployment to an AWS EC2 server and creating a quick demo video.
